title: Following @ volexity ’s September 9 blog post on two Chinese APT actors chaining 0-days in Chrome (CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491) & Windows
content_md:
Following @ volexity ’s September 9 blog post on two Chinese APT actors chaining 0-days in Chrome (CVE-2026-85046, CVE-2026-87491) & Windows

via Mastodon https://www.volexity.com/blog/2026/09/21/mind-the-patch-gap-part-2-fake-websites-used-to-deploy-chrome-windows-0-day-exploits/

CVE-2026-85046.evidence: Volexity reports Chinese APT actors actively exploiting this Chrome 0-day in chained attacks via fake websites

CVE-2026-87491.evidence: Volexity reports Chinese APT actors actively exploiting this Chrome 0-day in chained attacks

CVE-2026-85880.evidence: Windows ALPC heap overflow exploited in the wild as part of the Chrome+Windows 0-day chain
